title: Dangling doc comment before use statement in kith-peer
description: kith-peer/src/lib.rs lines 1065-1067: a triple-slash doc comment ('/// Format a Unix timestamp…') sits immediately above a `use kith_core::unix_secs_to_rfc3339;` statement. Doc comments attach to the next item; a `use` item is not a public API surface and the comment misleadingly implies there is a local function by that name. The comment was likely left over from when the function lived inline here. Consequence: misleading to readers tracing the function definition; `cargo doc` may emit a 'missing documentation for a use item' warning on some compiler versions.
